test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

In an _____(endeavour) to improve the environment of their society, they planted many trees surrounding the parking area.
solution:
The correct answer is '**aim**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**aim**" means a purpose or intention; a desired outcome. (उद्देश्य)
 
• In the context of improving the environment, "aim" is synonymous with "endeavour" as it represents a goal or objective.
 
• The other options: "**axiom**," "**ecstasy**," and "**epitome**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *In an aim__ to improve the environment of their society, they planted many trees surrounding the parking area.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Axiom (स्वयंसिद्ध सत्य)**: means a statement or proposition regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true.
 
• **Ecstasy (परमानंद)**: means an overwhelming feeling of great happiness or joyful excitement.
 
• **Epitome (प्रतिमान)**: means a person or thing that is a perfect example of a particular quality or type.
